name: Quantum Entanglement Games
description: Play to verify theorem relationships. Each game tests a research lead.

games.title: Theorem Entanglement Proof #0
games.description: Test the hypothesized relationship: mul9_1_1 applies_to mul9_1_2
games.challenge: Navigate from mul9_1_1 to mul9_1_2 using only applies_to moves. If you succeed, the entanglement is real.
games.verify_condition: Reach mul9_1_2 in ≤ 7 moves using verified edges only

verification_model.success: Player reaches target theorem using only valid edges → entanglement sealed
verification_model.failure: Player cannot reach target → entanglement marked spurious
verification_model.timeout: Player exceeds move limit → entanglement remains open (inconclusive)

honest_scope: Games test structural hypotheses only (does A connect to B?), not theorem validity. Sealed theorems remain sealed regardless of game outcome. Games explore the entanglement graph.
